description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the SchedulerService component of the OpenMRS project, testing various aspects such as task scheduling, concurrency, task persistence, and behavior validation.

classes.name: SchedulerServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of the SchedulerService in OpenMRS, including concurrency, task persistence, and behavior validation.

classes.name: LatchTask
classes.description: Abstract base class for tasks that synchronize execution using a latch to test concurrency.

classes.name: LatchInitializeTask
classes.description: Task that waits during initialization until all tasks call wait, used to test concurrent initialization.

classes.name: LatchExecuteTask
classes.description: Task that waits during execution until all tasks call wait, used to test concurrent execution.

classes.name: InitSequenceTestTask
classes.description: Task that verifies whether execution occurs after initialization without interleaving.

classes.name: BareTask
classes.description: A minimal implementation of Task for testing purposes that does not extend AbstractTask.

classes.name: StoreExecutionTimeTask
classes.description: Task that records its execution time, used for verifying last execution time persistence.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, cleans existing tasks, and sets log levels.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Restores log levels after each test.

methods.name: shouldResolveValidTaskClass
methods.description: Tests that a valid task class can be loaded and instantiated.

methods.name: shouldNotResolveInvalidClass
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid class name throws ClassNotFoundException.

methods.name: makeRepeatingTaskThatStartsImmediately
methods.description: Creates and registers a task definition that starts immediately and repeats after a set interval.

methods.name: shouldAllowTwoTasksToRunConcurrently
methods.description: Tests that two tasks schedule simultaneously can run concurrently.

methods.name: shouldAllowTwoTasksInitMethodsToRunConcurrently
methods.description: Tests concurrent initialization of two tasks.

methods.name: checkTasksRunConcurrently
methods.description: Helper to verify concurrent execution of tasks using CountDownLatch.

methods.name: shouldNotAllowTaskExecuteToRunBeforeInitializationIsComplete
methods.description: Verifies that a task's execute method runs only after its initialize method completes.

methods.name: saveTask_shouldSaveTaskToTheDatabase
methods.description: Tests that a task is saved and registered in the database with correct creator info.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowExceptionWhenTaskDefinitionIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that scheduling a task that does not implement getTaskDefinition does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: shouldSaveLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Ensures that the last execution time of a task is recorded accurately.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid_shouldGetTaskByUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving a task by its UUID.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid_shouldReturnNullWhenUuidDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that fetching a non-existent UUID returns null.
